verdict.rationale: cubic's memory-and-learning docs say you can reply to its comments explaining what it should do differently and "it remembers for next time." Thumbs up/down reactions also help it calibrate useful feedback versus noise, and it learns from direct feedback on its comments. This covers pushing back and having the reviewer learn, though all of it is vendor-claimed. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that rejected feedback actually stops recurring, and documentation of how learned memories are scoped, viewed or edited.
